PROVISIONAL_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL. +Strionic Resonator +Echo, Perceptive Prodigy +Twenty-Toed Toad +Sea Gate Restoration // Sea Gate, Reborn +Deflecting Swat +Mana Drain / -Emry, Lurker of the Loch -Goblin Engineer -Sai, Master Thopterist -Dark Deal -Mana Geyser -Seething Song. 33 lands + Sea Gate MDFC, 9 rocks, avg nonland MV 3.369, pips 41/20/26. Adds Spellbook 1561-5850 (Toad + Peer, win the game). Losses: artifact recursion/value creatures, Dark Deal, two rituals.

REJECT (five-swap floor, staged). First five swaps, Seething Song kept. Song's five-mana burst is one-shot; Mana Drain protects the Cecily attack turn and its delayed mana pays for Lutri or post-combat spells. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (six-swap, staged). Pass C's exact challenger (Resonator over In Garruk's Wake) with the other five swaps; Emry kept. Pass C itself defended Wake as a top free-cast payoff; cutting Emry keeps the one-sided wipe. HIGH confidence.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (seven-swap, staged, not selected). Preferred six + Enter the Infinite over Wheel of Misfortune. A free-cast library draw, but uncastable by hand and Peer + Toad already covers the job. MODERATE confidence.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (seven-swap, staged, not selected). Preferred six + Peter Parker's Camera over Lightning Greaves. A third trigger copier is overkill and Greaves' haste lets Cecily attack the turn she lands. MODERATE confidence.
